files.plan-register.md:
# Cragside Fell Quarries - restoration plan register

Revision 7 of the restoration plan applies to working between 2 November 2026 and 28 February 2027. The minerals officer approved it on 19 August 2026.

## What this revision changes
Haul roads are watered through dry spells.
Soil heaps are seeded before the winter.
files.working-notes.md:
# Working notes

The winterside face is worked through the winter while the eastern face rests.
Haul road watering is logged by the weighbridge clerk.
